title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of good quality captures a standout Pigpen‑led Big Boy Pete with lively Jerry/Bob vocal trading.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews suggest the tape is a solid soundboard source that sounds clear enough for listeners to enjoy. The performance shines on the rare Pigpen version of “Big Boy Pete,” where Bob and Jerry trade lyrics and keep the energy high, making it a memorable moment despite the lack of detailed technical commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review praises the show’s performance while the other gives a modest 3‑star rating, indicating decent but not exceptional recording quality; weighted average yields a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers found the audio clear enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited commentary, but the highlight is the energetic vocal exchange on Big Boy Pete, suggesting a lively mid‑set moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for trading lyrics with Bob and delivering strong vocals on Big Boy Pete.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for sharing lyrical duties with Jerry during the Pigpen version of Big Boy Pete.
